bibl.title: More Land, More Production, or More Taxes? Growth and the Apion Estate.
bibl.seg: Ryan McConnell, More Land, More Production, or More Taxes? Growth and the Apion Estate.
bibl.note: Evaluates the size and production of the Apion estate by comparing six accounts from administrative divisions of the estate, προστασίαι, with two estate-wide accounts separated by 45 years in the sixth century CE.
